name: Honda Super Cub C90
engine: 89 cc air-cooled OHC single, one carb, semi-automatic gearbox
intro: The step-through Cub. Simple and tough. Rust, old wiring and a gummed carb are the usual jobs.

H: Check the valve clearances. On these small Hondas they tend to close up and the engine runs poorly.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Rust and electrics
known.what: Rust and old electrics are the usual trouble on aging C90s.
